findings.summary: Five assertions in this file still hold the superseded rule that an excluded path is charged nothing (wide-gate-head.log: 5 failed, 24 passed, EXIT=1 against 21 passed at the base); the done-when gate and the manifest's tests: line both name this file, so the tree is red at the head and the promotion gate receipt will be red until its docstring and token assertions are rewritten for the reference charge, which lies outside this node's fence.

REFERENCE_TOKENS is imported from the module under test, so the reference-charge assertions at :118, :119, :125, :142, :144 and :258 move with the code's own constant and stay green if its value changes; only :254 and :120 pin the magnitude from an independent source.

The same-path case (a path both prohibited and a declared write path) is resolved to the full charge alone, a reading the plan's done-when does not settle; it is stated in the landing line and is never cheaper than the edit, so it needs a coordinator decision rather than a repair.
